story_description: Install compiled hooks into Claude Code, manage scope, and visualize active hooks.
task_description: The visual builder must write the compiled `hooks.json` into Claude Code so the CLI can actually trigger hooks. Without a concrete install path and verification step, the system is only a UI.
atom_description: The visual builder must write the compiled `hooks.json` into Claude Code so the CLI can actually trigger hooks. Without a concrete install path and verification step, the system is only a UI.
problem_statement: The visual builder must write the compiled `hooks.json` into Claude Code so the CLI can actually trigger hooks. Without a concrete install path and verification step, the system is only a UI.
scope_in: Resolve user vs project hook locations; write compiled `hooks.json`; create backups; verify CLI triggers; report install status
Implement HooksInstallationService.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Canvas rendering and node configuration UI (handled by other atoms)
Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: Claude Code CLI is installed and available as `claude`
Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
constraints: Must create `.claude/` directory if missing
Must not overwrite existing hooks without a backup
Must validate compiled JSON before writing
Must not block the main UI thread
Must not block main UI thread
Must use glass styling via DSGlass for all settings panels
Must support keyboard navigation (accessibility)
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval
At least one event node per graph
UpdatedInput only under PreToolUse or PermissionRequest with allow
Stop gate only under Stop or SubagentStop with loop safety
Conflict resolution: continue false wins, deny beats allow, ask beats allow, PostToolUse block forces remediation
Exit 0 success, stdout visible in verbose; UserPromptSubmit and SessionStart may inject into context
Exit 2 blocks with error handling per event
Other exit codes are non-blocking and continue execution
Event nodes: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, SessionStart, SessionEnd
Filter nodes: Matcher and Predicate
Action nodes: Command, Prompt, Agent
Control nodes: Decision Allow Deny Ask, Permission Decision, Block with Reason, Continue or Stop
Transformation nodes: Updated Input, Additional Context, System Message
Utility nodes: Logger, Export Trace, Rate limit or Debounce
Left panel node palette with Events, Filters, Actions, Utilities
Center panel canvas with pan, zoom, and grid background
Right panel inspector with node properties, tooltips, and validation errors
Top bar actions: Back, Save, Discard, Test run, Export
Space plus drag to pan canvas
Cmd plus scroll to zoom
Cmd C and Cmd V to copy and paste nodes
Delete to remove node
Cmd S to save, Cmd Enter to test run, Cmd Z to undo, Cmd Shift Z to redo
Cmd I to focus inspector, M to toggle minimap
functional_requirements: Provide `installHooks(scope:, compiledHooks:)` to write `hooks.json` to the selected scope
Provide `uninstallHooks(scope:)` to remove installed hooks for a scope
Provide `listInstalledHooks()` that reads user and project hooks and returns a merged view with scope labels
Provide `verifyHooks(scope:)` that runs a minimal CLI trigger and confirms the hook fires
Support all hook events: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, SessionStart, SessionEnd.
Support node taxonomy for events, filters, actions, control, transformation, and utility nodes.
Persist graph with nodes and edges and validate against semantic rules.
nonfunctional_requirements: Install/uninstall operations complete in under 250ms for typical hook files
Verification should fail fast (timeout 5s) with actionable errors
implementation_steps: Create `HooksInstallationService.swift` with a dedicated actor for file IO
Add path resolution for user and project scopes
Validate compiled JSON against the hooks schema before writing
Write file atomically using a temp file + rename
Implement backup creation and restore on failure
Implement CLI verification by running a test hook and checking a marker file
api_contracts: `resolveHookPaths(scope:)` -> returns absolute path for hooks.json and backup dir
`installHooks(scope:compiledHooks:)` -> throws on validation or write failure
ui_states: Idle saved state with no unsaved changes
Dirty state with unsaved changes and save enabled
Validating state during schema and semantic checks
Error state with validation errors and save disabled
Saving and Saved states with success toast
Discard confirm modal when leaving with unsaved changes
ui_interactions: No direct UI interactions; called by lifecycle tooling
Drag nodes from palette to canvas and connect ports to create edges.
Select node to edit config in inspector with tooltips and examples.
Run test execution and display validation results.
ui_copy: Top bar buttons: Back, Save, Discard, Test run, Export.
Inspector shows short tooltip and long learn more text for each node.
edge_cases: `hooks.json` missing for a scope - install should create it
Corrupt existing `hooks.json` - backup and replace with validated version
CLI not installed - verification fails with a clear error
failure_modes: Write permission denied - surface error and keep previous file intact
Verification timeout - report failure and keep install result
rollback_plan: Restore the latest backup and remove the new `hooks.json`

integration: Install to temp directory and verify file contents
Integration test HooksInstallationService.swift with dependent stores or managers.
ui: Verify SwiftUI previews render without crash.
security: Ensure backups do not expose secrets in logs
Ensure no sensitive data is logged.

log_expectations: INFO: Installed hooks to [path] with [count] entries
acceptance_tests: Install to project scope and confirm `.claude/hooks.json` exists
Run CLI verification and confirm the marker file is created
acceptance_criteria: Installing hooks writes valid JSON to the selected scope
Verification confirms the CLI fires at least one hook
Backups are created and can be restored
completed_when: All definition of done criteria are met and verification steps pass.
completed_evidence: Passing tests, verification steps completed, and artifact outputs present.
open_questions: No open questions; specification is complete for this atom.
verification_steps: Install to project scope and confirm `.claude/hooks.json` exists
Run CLI verification and confirm the marker file is created

risks: Incorrect install path prevents hooks from firing
mitigations: Path resolution tests and explicit scope labels
risk_register.fallback_plan: Use project scope only and disable user scope
